generation.mode: single built-in image_gen whole-canvas edit with edit-target.jpg first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.method: Rec.709 luminance central-difference gradients on nonwater source pixels, magnitude at least 12; 36 directed angle bins; peak bin divided by the uniform-bin mean.
lightingIsotropy.limitation: The aggregate orientation statistic is not proof of flat lighting because terrain geometry and brush texture also affect it.
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: FAIL: basalt caps and upper rock planes are repeatedly paler than vertical faces, and conifer crowns retain internal light-dark modelling instead of one flat value. No coherent cast-shadow field is visible, but that does not satisfy the literal equal-value rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual full-frame screen-space estimate as fractions of nonwater land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The pale north shelf, west glades, two level gorge shoulders and fallen-tree clearing count as buildable; exposed gorge walls and sharp talus banks count as steep; dense stands and rough non-steep ground make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: Screen-space visual estimate with approximate uncertainty of plus or minus 0.08 per fraction, not an elevation-derived slope measurement.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution bank-to-bank trace over the complete visible beck and gorge-water surfaces, including both falls, foam, shaded pools, wash, ripples and reflections; binary outline and tint overlay inspected against the raw source.

crown.method: Connected-component census of all 54 separable dark-green conifer crowns, including saplings and edge or overlap cases; median outer source width 22 px scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

refusalReasons: The highest-priority lighting rule fails visually: repeated pale basalt caps and upper planes over darker vertical faces encode directional form shading despite the absence of cast shadows.
Conifer crowns retain internal lighter and darker modelling instead of one flat value from tip to skirt.
The required grey-blue haze is too weak to soften every crown edge; many stand silhouettes remain hard.
verified: Exactly one whole-canvas built-in edit call with both required images attached
1254 x 1254 square PNG, byte-identical to the raw tool output
No new buildings, walls, roads, bridges, docks, boats, fences, figures, rail, track, tunnel mouths, rune marks or paths observed in the authored area
Water mask dimensions match source; opaque pixels are white, alpha is binary, and no interior holes remain
Water overlay covers the west beck, gorge stream, two falls, foam, shaded pools, wash, ripples and reflections
All 54 separable measured conifer crowns were retained in the census; median is within the 1.7-5.2 m band
